Name: Matching Demetrius Sprite
Author: badboyzay
Description:
Demetrius sprite doesn't resemble his portrait much, his hair also looks weird like he's wearing a cap or something. So I've decided to adjust his sprite: his skin and shirt have been lighten up to similar tone from his portrait (he and Maru look more similar now!), his hair also has been adjusted to look like proper hair.

[b]Note:[/b]
This mod doesn't change his portrait, only his sprite so that he matches his vanilla portrait.

[b]How to install:
[/b]Simply put the content in your Stardew Valley folder.

[b]Permission:
[/b]You are free to do whatever you want with my mods as long as you credit me.
